text:
sarah (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the headcount gating and the small structural changes. i'll keep this as an operational thread with clear next steps. pls drop short q's.
jen (Recruiting): to confirm  are we pausing postings or adding an intake gate?
tom (VP Eng): intake gate only. new reqs must include a one-line impact statement + OKR tie and a "priority_bucket" (Serving, Dedicated, CustomerReliability, Growth). we'll screen at intake and only approve mapped roles for the next quarter.
claire (Dir Product): what counts as an OKR tie? a one-liner is fine?
sarah (CEO): yes  one line: metric impacted + target timeline (e.g., "reduce p99 by 30% for inference-latency in Q2"). customer retention or SLA items get higher weight.
maria (People Ops): process: managers open a ticket in internal/hires; include "priority_bucket" + one-line OKR tie; tag @jen + @tom. triage cadence will be Tue/Fri. internal transfers automatically receive priority if posted in #internal-moves and cc'd to People Ops.
ben (Eng): curious  any change to backfill rules? some teams rely on quick backfills for Pager duty.
tom (VP Eng): backfills that preserve on-call and SLA commitments and map to a priority_bucket are auto-approved. others go through normal triage.
emma (Growth PM): growth/product roles  will they be blocked? we have renewal-related hires.
jen (Recruiting): tag those tickets "urgent-customer" and include the renewal/contract number; those jump to the top.
ben (Eng): hiring mix guidance? senior vs mid vs junior?
sarah (CEO): aim for ~60% senior+ for infra/serving work to move foundational pieces quickly; 40% mid-level for throughput. juniors allowed only with explicit mentoring pair.
claire (Dir Product): any org shape changes beyond pod merges? i heard something about matrix leads.
tom (VP Eng): small change: we'll introduce two "matrix leads" (technical leads who sit across Serving + Product) to speed cross-functional projects; they are IC++ roles, not new manager slots. details & selection process will be posted by Fri.
maria (People Ops): comp bands unchanged for now. matrix lead pay adjustments handled case-by-case; submit a People Ops exception request if needed.
emma (Growth PM): internal mobility process specifics? 
jen (Recruiting): post in #internal-moves, add role interest + skills, cc your manager. People Ops will fast-track interviews and leveling.
ben (Eng): interview loops: will panels shrink? we had long loops last cycle.
jen (Recruiting): yes  leaner panels for priority buckets to speed decisions. updated interview templates go live tomorrow.
claire (Dir Product): visa/sponsorship guidance? we have two candidates in flight.
maria (People Ops): existing offers and active candidates continue. new reqs requiring sponsorship flagged at intake will be reviewed per-region; add "sponsorship_required" in ticket metadata.
ben (Eng): curious about timeline for org chart publish.
sarah (CEO): org sketches + matrix lead descriptions by Fri EOD; read-only headcount buckets sheet (Serving/Dedicated/Product/Research/CS) live by Mon.
tom (VP Eng): managers: if you need a 1:1 to map team responsibilities or propose a matrix lead, DM me and i'll schedule a 30-min sync.
sarah (CEO): thanks all  we'll keep updating this thread. if there's appetite, we'll run a 30-min AMA later this week to walk through the org map and the intake gating flow. :thumbsup: 
ticket-bot: follow-up doc uploaded: internal/allhands/2026-08-12-headcount-gating.md
